title: Contact record pipeline: Firehose transform and Athena-style KPI SQL
scenario: LFG streams contact records through Kinesis and Amazon Data Firehose into an S3 data lake queried by Athena. The pilot transformation Lambda leaked phone numbers and a card number, failed whole batches on one bad record, counted canary calls, and gave S3 lifecycle no way to apply per-contact retention. Fix the Lambda and write the KPI views.
task: Implement the Firehose transformation contract: Ok / Dropped / ProcessingFailed per record
Flatten contact records into analytics rows with handle time, answered/abandoned/contained flags
Hash phone numbers, drop deny-listed attributes, redact SSNs and Luhn-valid card numbers
Return dynamic partition keys: channel, dt, retention class
Write Athena-portable SQL views: queue_daily, agent_occupancy, containment_by_intent
acceptance: A malformed record fails alone; canaries are dropped
No raw phone number in any output; redaction rules exact
Partition keys and retention classes correct
View results match independently computed KPIs on the sample
